# Mandatory CES Events — Tuesday/Thursday Scheduling, Scope & Dependency Ledger

**Branch:** `evidence`  ·  **Target year:** 2026  ·  **Source of truth:** `src/policy/data/regulatoryEvents.ts` → `REGULATORY_EVENTS`
**Generated by data analysis** (`scripts/analyzeMandatoryEvents.ts`), not by hand.

> **STATUS: FAILED — MANDATORY EVENT COVERAGE INCOMPLETE.**
> The Tuesday/Thursday scheduling rule and explicit scope labelling are now
> implemented and verified, and the dependency-gated completion engine already
> exists and passes its dataflow tests. **But** several mandated items are not
> yet present: an October next‑year **budget** event, full **monthly coverage**
> for some families, and the **monthly→quarterly→annual rollup dependency wiring**.
> Browser smoke was **not run** (UNVERIFIED). Details below.

---

## What was implemented this pass

The CES calendar already contained **247 events for 2026** across all domains, with
a working dependency-gated completion engine. Two systemic pipeline steps were added
to `REGULATORY_EVENTS` (after `enforceBusinessDay`, before alignment):

1. **`enforceTuesdayThursday`** (`src/policy/data/tuesdayThursdayPolicy.ts`)
   Snaps recurring events to the nearest **same‑month** Tue/Thu (scope‑safe; event
   IDs unchanged so `dependsOn` stays valid). Tue = prep/review/monthly; Thu =
   committee/approval/rollup/quarterly+annual. Fixed/holiday/trigger events preserved.
2. **`deriveScope`** (`src/policy/data/scopeDerivationPolicy.ts`)
   Sets an explicit `scopeLabel`/`scopeType` from cadence + date where absent
   (monthly→prev month, quarterly→prev quarter, annual→prior year or planning).

**Measured effect (live `REGULATORY_EVENTS`, 2026):**

| Metric | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tue/Thu compliance | 80/247 (32%) | **244/247 (99%)** |
| Weekday spread | Mon 106, Wed 42, Thu 41, Tue 39, Fri 19 | **Tue 183, Thu 61**, Mon 2, Fri 1 |
| Events with explicit scope | 2/247 | **240/247** |
| Gates: `validate:event-dataflow` | n/a | **8/8 PASS** |
| `tsc -b --noEmit` / `npm run build` | n/a | **PASS / PASS** |

## 3. Dependency ledger (gate IS enforced by the engine; data wiring is partial)

Gate enforcement lives in `src/policy/compliance/complianceEngine.ts` (flips status to
`blocked` when a `dependsOn` event isn't complete) and `eventStateEvaluator.ts`
(`canCertify=false` while blockers exist). Verified by `validate:event-dataflow` (8/8 PASS).

| Event ID | Depends on | Gate type | Completion blocked when missing? | Verified? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `qapi_meeting-20260507-08` (Q2) | `qapi_meeting-20260205-04` (Q1) | upstream-complete | Yes (engine) | ✅ engine + dataflow test |
| `qapi_meeting-20260806-12` (Q3) | Q2 | upstream-complete | Yes | ✅ |
| `qapi_meeting-20261105-16` (Q4) | Q3 | upstream-complete | Yes | ✅ |
| `qapi_annual_eval-20261210-01` | Q4 | upstream-complete | Yes | ✅ |
| `governing_body_meeting-*` | QAPI + compliance + risk events | upstream-complete | Yes | ✅ |

**GAP:** Only **5 events** carry `dependsOn`. The mandated **monthly→quarterly** rollup
(e.g., Q1 QAPI dependsOn Jan+Feb+Mar monthly QAPI) is **NOT wired** — the quarterly
events chain to the prior *quarter*, and monthly QAPI exists only for May/Jun. Wiring
this requires generating the missing monthly events first (see §5).
